_about: Published JWST results for Patchwork planets, for comparison with the uniform reduction. depth_ppm: published white-light (Rp/R*)^2 per detector [NRS1, NRS2] (or a single same-band value), computed from the quoted Rp/R* where that is what the paper gives. mu: published mean-molecular-weight constraint in amu -- {lower} or {low, high}; mu_from says whether it was quoted as mu or converted from a metallicity (solar-scaled H/He gas, metals as H2O/CH4/CO: 100x ~ mu 4.2-4.6, 300x ~ 7.6-10, 1000x ~ 16). Compiled 2026-10-22; every entry needs a citation.

GJ 1214 b.ref: Ohno et al. 2025, ApJL 979, L7 (arXiv:2410.10186); data Schlawin et al. 2024
GJ 1214 b.verdict: Thick aerosols over a metal-dominated atmosphere, [M/H] ~ 3.5; tentative CO2

GJ 357 b.verdict: Featureless; mu < 8 and Z < 300x solar excluded at 3 sigma; high-mu secondary atmosphere or bare rock

GJ 9827 d.ref: Piaulet-Ghorayeb et al. 2024, ApJL (arXiv:2410.03527), NIRISS/SOSS + HST
GJ 9827 d.verdict: Steam world: H2O is the background gas, VMR > 31%
GJ 9827 d.mu_from: converted from H2O VMR > 31% in H2/He

L 98-59 d.verdict: High-mu secondary atmosphere favoured; tentative H2S and SO2; unocculted faculae

TOI-836.01.verdict: Featureless; Z < 175x solar excluded unless aerosols sit above ~1 mbar

HD 15337 b.verdict: Flat once an NRS1-NRS2 offset is allowed; Z < 50x solar excluded

LTT 3780 c.ref: Rigby et al. 2025, ApJL 995, L70 (arXiv:2512.15844), as TOI-732 c
LTT 3780 c.verdict: CH4 (~1% VMR) in an H2-rich atmosphere; extra absorption from hydrocarbons or S species

TOI-1231 b.verdict: Spot crossings in both white-light curves

TOI-125 b.verdict: Muted: clear Z >= 150x solar, or clouds above ~3 mbar (2 sigma)

TOI-125 c.verdict: Only ~70% of the transit observed (TTVs); clear Z > 100x solar or clouds ~10 mbar

GJ 3090 b.verdict: Highly muted G395H spectrum, no CH4; Z > 100x solar for clouds at ~ubar; He escape detected

TOI-776 c.verdict: No strong features; Z < 180-240x solar excluded for clouds deeper than 1 mbar

TOI-776 b.verdict: Muted; low-metallicity clear atmospheres excluded (limits differ by reduction and visit)

TOI-836 b.verdict: Featureless in two visits; not an H2-dominated atmosphere

K2-18 b.ref: Madhusudhan et al. 2023, ApJL; Schmidt et al. 2025 reanalysis
